items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Donald Byrd, what's his name, Charlie Byrd went down there and he did some things down there.

ctx.x: What's your first memory of Bossa Nova coming in?

Dizzy coming back from South America talking about this beautiful music and then Donald Byrd, what's his name, Charlie Byrd went down there and he did some things down there. Then, naturally, Stan Getz made the two recordings and they were a big hit: "The Girl from Ipanema", especially, and "Desafinado". It's marvelous really music. I'm sorry it didn't become popular in this country. I think if the American public could have learned to dance to it, that would have been wonderful, because it was just made for jazz…

I know that in recent years you've taken to singing a good number of Louis Armstrong and you've always had very good things to say about him. I wonder what is your memory of the first...of your first hearing of Louis Armstrong, perhaps your first contact with him and how that progressed over the years.
